prompt: Our designer used a light gray (#CCCCCC) text on white background for secondary information throughout the app. I think this fails contrast requirements but they say it 'looks cleaner.' Can you audit this and help me make the case?

assertions.text: Calculates the exact contrast ratio of #CCCCCC on white (1.6:1)
References correct WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
Provides specific alternative hex values that pass WCAG AA while maintaining clean aesthetic
Frames the argument for stakeholders using both legal compliance and UX reasoning
Explains why contrast requirements exist beyond compliance (usability, situational impairments)
